name_en: Refracted Illusory Butterfly of Entangled Lives::The Past
wiki_title: Illusory Butterfly of Entangled Lives::The Past
location: Line 6: Maru no Uchi no Sanzu no Kawa

passives.name: The Past - Segmentation [分節]
passives.text:
Displays current [In the Past] Stack on Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago
Every time this unit is hit as the main target:
- Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago loses 1 [In the Past] Stack (once per Coin)
- The Sinner who attacked this unit heals 10 SP (once per turn per Sinner)
If this unit did not get hit as the main target this turn, Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago gains 5 [In the Past] Stack at Combat End
- If Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago is Staggered, this effect does not activate

passives.name: The Past - Origination [緣起]
passives.text:
Fix this unit's Speed to 1; this unit's HP does not drop below 1
When this unit takes HP damage, transfer half of damage taken to Butterfly of Entangled Lives::Imago (rounded down)
